title: 第28章 还有救，还能救
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “来来来，喝水喝水！”丁腾飞提着两个热水瓶回到宿舍，不由分说的就开始给每个人杯子里倒水。而他突然的殷勤举动，也让众人感到十分不适应。但伸手不打笑脸人，他们也没有多说什么。反倒是丁腾飞主动开口，想要主动和大家搞好关系。“之前因为我一个人犯错，给大家惹了不少麻烦，实在对不住。”“在这，跟大家认个错，道个歉，希望你们大人不记小人过。”周凯东一口水差点儿没喷出来，这话从丁腾飞嘴里讲出来，不亚于太阳打西边出来！开看到陆阳冲着自已扬了扬眉毛，他立马反应过来。丁腾飞的突然转变，与陆阳有关。好小子，果然有一套！自已和指导员轮番谈话外加心理辅导，都没能办成的事儿，居然在陆阳这里被办成了？让陆阳来当这个副班长，管理宿舍纪律，果然是非常正确的决定！虽说，周凯东能看出丁腾飞说话时，眼里依旧带着点儿抵触。说明，他也是被逼无奈，才开的这个口，并不是发自真心。但万事开头难，只要他愿意开这个头，那就是一件好事。说明这个兵还有救，说明这小子至少有一个想要变好的心。而对于丁腾飞的主动承认错误的举动，大家态度还算比较包容，但该吐槽还是得吐槽。“我们倒还好，反正你惹麻烦，倒霉的都是你自已，又不是我们。”“上回你关禁闭，班长跟着受牵连，还当着全连的面做了检讨。”“得亏后来班副帮我们找回点儿脸面，不然我都想找个缝钻进去。”“以后别有事儿没事儿小报告，跟个山炮一样。还有说话事后嘴巴放干净点，别总是浪里马，浪里马的，不带脏字不会说话咋地？”有些话，说开了也就说开了，年轻人的脾气来得快，去的也快。只要不是那种，坏到骨头渣滓里的那种，大家也愿意给的机会。不然，宿舍里莫名其妙的多个不合群的家伙，他们也挺不自在，像是住进了个陌生人一样。而对于丁腾飞，大家的诉求也很简单，安分守已别搞事就行。部队里最喜欢搞一人生病，集体打针这一套。只要有一个人犯错，一群人都得跟在后头倒霉。但最倒霉的，肯定是丁腾飞这个当事人，成天挨骂挨罚还被排挤换谁也受不了。所以，他先前才会主动去水房找到陆阳谈谈，想让陆阳给支支招帮他脱离苦海。陆阳也是不计前嫌，告诉他要把姿态放低，不要脑袋昂在天上，觉得老子天下第一。来当兵了，大家都是同一起跑线，外头那套根本不管用，也唬不住人。不想被人讨厌，不想被老兵一遍遍搞到心态崩溃，那就必须改变。部队不会去迎合你，那你就必须主动去迎合部队。而放低姿态端茶倒水，主动承认之前的错误，就是陆阳教他的第一步。起初丁腾飞很抗拒，觉得这很丢脸，甚至有些难以启齿，但说出来也就说出来了，好像也没少块肉。“都是一个班的，天南海北的能够遇到一起也不容易。”周凯东也讲了两句：“以前的不愉快，就此翻篇，以后学点儿好，训练认真点。尤其不该出风头的时候，别特么瞎出风头！”丁腾飞小鸡啄米一样连连点头。不嘴硬，也不反驳，这不挺好的吗？有了热水，大家将孔垄给的蛋白粉分批次倒了点儿在杯子里。每人稍稍的浅尝了一下，发现味道不如奶茶那么好喝。还有人觉得太腻喝不惯，又转头倒给了其他人。孔垄偷偷找到陆阳，想让他留一口给自已，为他那不断缩小的臂围续续命，但却被像鬼一样突然出现在身后周凯东吓得不轻。于是他只能心虚的将杯子还给陆阳，冲班长挤出一个礼貌又不失尴尬的笑容。“我就闻闻味儿，绝对不喝。”“呵，要是让我发现你偷喝，饿你一天！”“不会的不会的，我跟蛋白粉不共戴天！”就在这时，刺耳的哨声从楼下响起，紧跟着便是值班员的喊话声。“所有人戴帽子，扎腰带，楼下集合，准备跑步！”......“哎哟卧槽，来劲儿了！”“还真别说，这什么蛋白粉，是有效果，感觉两条腿都变轻了！”“有没有这么邪乎，我怎么一点儿感觉都没有？”“你喝的少了，我们喝得多。”中午的三公里，三班不少人健步如飞，步伐轻盈。也不知道是蛋白粉和肌酸真的有效，还是心理作用。就连陆阳都感觉身体里头热乎乎的，像是完成了一次充能。跑完步，众人稍作休整便拿上课本就去了阅览室，准备上思想政治课。思想政治是新训期间的必修课，而且需要考试，讲课的正是指导员何镇涛。天气冷了，阅览室关着门窗，再加上人多聚气，所以温度比外面要高出许多。正是比较暖和的缘故，导致大家刚把书放开，就不自觉的想要打哈欠。尤其是，这还是政治课，其催眠程度是仅次于数学和化学。前头的何镇涛像个教书先生一样，口若悬河的讲课，时不时还会再黑板上写写画画。底下的新兵们听得昏昏欲睡，眼皮子不停的打架，但还是得强行坐直身体，硬撑着。课堂上偷偷打个盹没事，老师可能会睁一只眼，闭一只眼。但在部队里，你眼皮但凡合上超过两秒，立马就是一脑瓜子。区别于其他人上课时的敷衍和煎熬，陆阳却学的十分认真，甚至有些投入。得益于系统的帮助，他的专注力已经得到提升；并且他在认真投入的学习新知识时，也能默默提高身体机能。明明是文化课，但在陆阳这里却硬生生出现了文武双全的收获，简直赢翻了！啪嗒！忽然，一支中性笔掉落在地，滚落到桌子底下。陆阳看到前排的孔垄低头弯腰去捡，但足足过了好几秒都没起身。陆阳身体微微后仰，余光正好能瞧见桌子底下的孔垄闭着眼睛张着嘴，身体定格在捡笔姿势一动不动，似乎是睡着了？“ZZZ......”轻微鼻息声传来，陆阳眼角抽动，他确定这家伙就是他娘的睡着了！
content_en: "Come, come, drink water!" Ding Tengfei returned to the dormitory carrying two thermos bottles and began to pour water into everyone's cups without any explanation.And his sudden solicitous behavior also made everyone feel very uncomfortable.But they didn’t reach out to hit the smiling person, and they didn’t say much.On the contrary, Ding Tengfei took the initiative to speak and wanted to take the initiative to build a good relationship with everyone."I caused a lot of trouble for everyone because of my mistakes. I'm really sorry." "Here, I admit my mistake and apologize to everyone. I hope you adults will not remember the villain's fault." Zhou Kaidong almost spit out water. When these words came out of Ding Tengfei's mouth, it was no less than the sun rising in the west!Kai saw Lu Yang raise his eyebrows at him, and he immediately reacted.Ding Tengfei's sudden change was related to Lu Yang.Good boy, you really have a trick!The thing that I couldn't accomplish despite repeated conversations with the instructor and psychological counseling was actually accomplished by Lu Yang?Letting Lu Yang be the deputy squad leader and manage dormitory discipline was indeed a very correct decision!Although, Zhou Kaidong could see that there was still a bit of resistance in Ding Tengfei's eyes when he spoke.It shows that he was forced to say this, and he didn't mean it from the bottom of his heart.But everything is difficult at the beginning. As long as he is willing to make this start, that is a good thing.It shows that this soldier can still be saved, and it shows that this boy at least has a desire to change for the better.As for Ding Tengfei's initiative to admit his mistakes, everyone's attitude was relatively tolerant, but he still had to complain when it was time to complain."It's okay for us. Anyway, if you cause trouble, it's you who is unlucky, not us." "Last time you were put in solitary confinement, the squad leader was implicated, and he even made a self-examination in front of the whole company." "Thankfully, the squad deputy helped us regain some face, otherwise I would have wanted to find a way to sneak in."From now on, don't make any small reports, just like a mountain gunman. Also, please keep your mouth clean after speaking. Don't be a liar. How can you not speak without using curse words?"Some things are easy to say, and young people's tempers come and go quickly.As long as it's not the kind that's so bad that it's just dregs of bones, everyone is willing to give it a chance.Otherwise, there are so many unsociable guys in the dormitory that are inexplicable, and they feel quite uncomfortable, as if they are living in a stranger.As for Ding Tengfei, everyone's appeal is also very simple, just stay calm and stop causing trouble.The most favorite thing in the army is to give a group injection when one person is sick.As long as one person makes a mistake, a group of others will be unlucky.But the most unlucky person must be Ding Tengfei. No one can stand being scolded, punished and ostracized all day long.That's why he took the initiative to go to the water house to talk to Lu Yang, hoping that Lu Yang could give him some advice to help him get out of his misery.Lu Yang also ignored the past grudges and told him to lower his attitude and not hold his head high in the sky. He felt that I was the best in the world.When you come to be a soldier, everyone starts from the same starting point. The tricks outside don’t work at all and cannot scare people.If you don’t want to be hated by others, and if you don’t want to be beaten by veterans over and over again until your mentality breaks down, then you must change.The troops will not cater to you, so you must take the initiative to cater to the troops.And lowering his posture when serving tea and pouring water, and taking the initiative to admit his previous mistakes, was the first step in Lu Yang's teaching to him.At first, Ding Tengfei was very resistant, thinking it was embarrassing and even a bit difficult to say, but he just said it, and it seemed like there was no missing piece of meat."We are all in the same class, and it is not easy for people from all over the world to meet together." Zhou Kaidong also said a few words: "Let's put aside the previous unhappiness. In the future, we will learn better and train more seriously. Especially when you shouldn't be in the limelight, don't be so blind!" Ding Tengfei nodded repeatedly like a chicken pecking at rice.Isn’t it good not to be harsh or to refute?With hot water, everyone poured some of the protein powder given by Kong Long into the cups in batches.Everyone had a little taste and found that the taste was not as good as milk tea.Some people found it too boring and couldn't get used to it, so they turned to others.Kong Long secretly found Lu Yang and wanted him to leave a mouthful for himself to save his shrinking arm circumference. However, he was frightened when Zhou Kaidong suddenly appeared behind him like a ghost.So he could only return the cup to Lu Yang with a guilty conscience, and gave the monitor a polite yet embarrassing smile."I'll just smell it, and I won't drink it." "Oh, if I find you drinking secretly, I'll starve you for the whole day!" "No, no, no, no, protein powder and I are sworn in!" At this moment, a harsh whistle sounded from downstairs, followed closely by the call of the attendant."Everyone put on their hats and belts, gathered downstairs, and got ready to run!"... "Oh shit, I'm so excited!" "Don't tell me, this protein powder is effective, my legs feel lighter!" "Is it so weird, why don't I feel anything at all?" "You drank less, we drank more." During the three kilometers at noon, many people in the third class walked as fast as flying, with light steps.I don’t know if protein powder and creatine are really effective, or if they are just psychological effects.Even Lu Yang felt warm inside his body, as if he had completed a recharge.After running, everyone took a short rest and then took their textbooks and went to the reading room to prepare for ideological and political classes.Ideology and politics is a compulsory course during the new training period and requires an examination. The instructor is He Zhentao who teaches.The weather is cold, the doors and windows of the reading room are closed, and there are many people gathering, so the temperature is much higher than outside.It was precisely because of the relatively warm weather that everyone unconsciously wanted to yawn as soon as they put down their books.Especially, this is a political class, its hypnotic degree is second only to mathematics and chemistry.He Zhentao in the front was like a teacher, giving lectures eloquently, and from time to time he would write and draw on the blackboard.The recruits below felt drowsy and their eyelids were twitching, but they still had to sit upright and hold on.It's okay to take a nap secretly in class, but the teacher may turn a blind eye.But in the army, if you close your eyelids for more than two seconds, you will immediately lose your mind.Different from others who were perfunctory and tormented in class, Lu Yang studied very seriously and was even somewhat devoted.Thanks to the help of the system, his concentration has been improved; and when he is seriously engaged in learning new knowledge, he can also quietly improve his physical functions.It was obviously a cultural class, but here in Lu Yang, there was a sudden gain of both civil and military skills. It was a win!Snap!Suddenly, a gel pen fell to the ground and rolled under the table.Lu Yang saw Kong Long in the front row lowering his head to pick it up, but he didn't get up for several seconds.Lu Yang leaned back slightly, and from the corner of his eye, he could just see Kong Rong under the table with his eyes closed and his mouth open. His body was frozen in the posture of picking up a pen. He seemed to be asleep?"ZZZ..." A slight snort came out, and the corners of Lu Yang's eyes twitched. He was sure that this guy was fucking asleep!
